broker_name.description: Unique name for this broker instance; used in JMX and cluster identification

data_directory.description: Root directory for all broker data (includes KahaDB, logs, etc.)

enable_statistics.description: Enable statistics collection (required for JMX metrics and web console)

enable_plug_ins.description: Enable external plugins (e.g., spring-based plugins) — list must be provided

plug_ins.description: List of plugin references (bean IDs) to inject into broker

ref.description: Spring bean ID of the plugin to instantiate

enable_jmx.description: Enable JMX management (must be true to expose JMX port)

jmx_port.description: Port for JMX RMI connector server (local only by default)

jmx_domain.description: JMX domain name used for MBean registration

kahadb_directory.description: Directory where KahaDB journal, index, and data files are stored

kahadb_journal_max_file_size_mb.description: Maximum size (MB) of each journal file before rotation

kahadb_index_cache_size.description: Number of index entries cached in memory

memory_usage_percent_of_jvm.description: Percentage of JVM heap to allocate to ActiveMQ memory usage (0–100)

store_usage_limit_gb.description: Maximum disk space (GB) for persistent message storage

temp_usage_limit_gb.description: Maximum disk space (GB) for temporary files (e.g., large messages, streaming)

transport_connectors.description: List of transport endpoints for client connections (e.g., OpenWire, MQTT, STOMP)

wire_format_opts.description: List of key=value wire format options (e.g., ['maxInactivityDuration=30000'])

network_connectors.description: Optional list of network connectors to bridge to other brokers

dynamic_only.description: Only forward messages to destinations with active consumers on downstream brokers

prefetch.description: Number of messagesprefetched per consumer over the network

decrease_priority.description: Reduce consumer priority for network connections (helps local consumers)

destination_policy_entries.description: List of destination-specific policies (queues/topics) to control behavior

dead_letter_queue.description: Name of queue to hold expired/unroutable messages

memory_limit_mb.description: Max memory (MB) allowed for this destination before backpressure

max_entries.description: Maximum number of messages cached in memory (for slow consumers)

use_cache.description: Whether to cache messages in memory

expire_messages_period.description: Interval (ms) between runs to check for expired messages

inactive_timeout.description: Time (ms) after which an unused destination is eligible for GC

max_producers_audit.description: Max number of producers tracked to prevent duplicates

max_consumers_audit.description: Max number of consumers tracked to prevent duplicate deliveries

auth_rules.description: Authorization rules mapping destination patterns to roles

group.description: Human-readable label for this rule (for documentation)

admin.description: Roles allowed to manage destination (e.g., delete, purge)
